entities.name: Matej Šebenik
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Matej Šebenik is a Slovenian chess player. He was awarded the title of Grandmaster (GM) by FIDE in 2012. He won the Slovenian Chess Championship in 2014. In 2009, he won the San Sebastián tournament.
